arguments.title: 야옹 멍멍 짝짝 | 모모타임
arguments.lyrics:
[Hook - immediate clear sung phrases; one short line per bar]
고양이 야옹!
야옹 야옹!
강아지 멍멍!
멍멍 멍멍!
고양이 야옹!
야옹 야옹!
강아지 멍멍!
멍멍 멍멍!

[Clap - same short tune, clear handclap pulse]
야옹 야옹!
짝짝 짝짝!
멍멍 멍멍!
짝짝 짝짝!

[Hook - repeat the exact melody and rhythm]
고양이 야옹!
야옹 야옹!
강아지 멍멍!
멍멍 멍멍!
고양이 야옹!
야옹 야옹!
강아지 멍멍!
멍멍 멍멍!

[Clap - no new vocabulary]
야옹 야옹!
짝짝 짝짝!
멍멍 멍멍!
짝짝 짝짝!

[Final hook - same melody, no acceleration]
고양이 야옹!
야옹 야옹!
강아지 멍멍!
멍멍 멍멍!
고양이 야옹!
야옹 야옹!
강아지 멍멍!
멍멍 멍멍!

[Short sung ending - resolve and stop]
고양이 야옹!
강아지 멍멍!
짝짝 짝짝!
[End]
arguments.style: Bright clear light youthful female solo, Korean toddler clap-chant dance song for ages 2-4. 120 BPM, steady bouncy 4/4 beat, dry handclaps on 2 and 4, soft kick, round plucky synth bass, playful woodblock and tiny tom accents. Native Korean pronunciation, clearly separate every syllable of go-yang-i and gang-a-ji. One short three-note hook, repeat the exact melody and rhythm every time. Brief animal-name call then easy meow or woof response, clear small breaths. Friendly pitched singing, not spoken rap. Light sparse accompaniment below the lead; tiny unison doubles only on responses. Begin singing within one second, no instrumental break, no long build. Lively and catchy without rushing. Natural short sung ending and final chord; no restart or long outro. About 75 seconds.
